_comment: The v3 baseline on the WAVE 6 bed (s59-s94, 36 hand-authored 10x10 crops) — the first god-lab corpus on the arenas the phone actually plays. Shipped v3 rules, the three presets, stratified 12-stage spread x both orientations x 1 seed = 24 games per arm. Run one process per arm (--arms). v4 (2026-09-05) is measured against this.
